children.role_hint: Clocked dynamic strong-arm style comparator core with differential input pair, tail switch, precharge devices, regenerative cross-coupled latch, and internal dynamic storage capacitances. It converts the differential input Vin/Vip into internal latched nodes Vx/Vy under clk control. No standalone DC bias generator or diode-connected bias node is present; clk is a timing/control input rather than an analog bias.

MN5 Vy Vx vdd vdd pmos w=W4 l=L4 nf=1 m=1
MN7 Vx clk vdd vdd pmos w=W5 l=L5 nf=1 m=1

children.role_hint: Static CMOS inverter output buffer driven by internal latch node Vy, producing the top-level comparator output Von. It restores the complementary dynamic latch signal to a full-swing output level.
